name: Miscrits: World of Creatures
description:
Start your journey in Sunfall Kingdom and explore the vast and vibrant surroundings! Find and capture hundreds of unique and iconic Miscrits of various types, strength and rarity. Train and evolve your Miscrits into increasingly powerful forms and watch your Miscripedia fill up!

A mysterious group called the Magicites have vowed to destroy all Miscrits to keep magic under control of the humans. You're Miscria's only hope at stopping them! Their leader, Apollo Nox, has summoned six Elementums that are draining the magic from Miscrits. Deal with the Magicites and defeat all six Elementums to enter his domain and take him down!

Take on other players in strategic combat at the arena! Take part in various different Arena formats, each with their own rules and rewards. Conquer the leaderboards and become the best player you can be!

Join our Discord of over 50,000 members to showcase your Miscrits, ask questions, discuss strategies and see update details as soon as they're announced! Miscrits is still a work in progress, and there are many updates and expansions planned for the foreseeable future, as well as consistent balance patches to keep the meta fresh and evolving!

Miscrits is a game built by the players, for the players. While there are in-game purchases, all in-game content can be accessed completely for free. No matter how you choose to play, you'll have access to the same tools and content as everyone else!
